name: cermont-monorepo
description: Cermont S.A.S. - Sistema de Gestión Operativa - Monorepo npm workspaces

scripts.quality:strict: npm run quality:weak-tokens && npm run quality:language && npm run quality:semantics && npm run quality:routes && npm run quality:dtos && npm run quality:zero && npm run quality:lint-residue && npm run quality:service-size && npm run quality:env
scripts.verify:shared-types: npm run typecheck -w @cermont/shared-types && npm run lint -w @cermont/shared-types && npm run test -w @cermont/shared-types && npm run build -w @cermont/shared-types
scripts.verify:domain: npm run typecheck -w @cermont/domain && npm run lint -w @cermont/domain && npm run build -w @cermont/domain
scripts.verify:config: npm run typecheck -w @cermont/config && npm run lint -w @cermont/config && npm run build -w @cermont/config
scripts.verify:backend: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run lint -w backend && npm run test -w backend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.verify:frontend: npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run lint -w frontend && npm run test -w frontend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.verify: npm run verify:shared-types && npm run verify:domain && npm run verify:config && npm run verify:backend && npm run verify:frontend && npm run contracts:check && npm run quality:strict && npm run doctor:verbose -w frontend
scripts.verify:strict: npm run contracts:check && npm run typecheck -- --force && npm run lint -- --force && npm run test -- --force && npm run doctor:verbose -w frontend && npm run build -- --force && npm run quality:strict
